run_interactive_viewer: run the habitat sim interactive viewer with a specified scene file and physics enabled
run_viewer_batch_render: run the habitat sim viewer in batch rendering mode with multiple concurrent environments
review_HabitatSimInteractiveViewer: review the HabitatSimInteractiveViewer class that extends Magnum GLFW Application for interactive 3D viewing
review_MarkerSetsEditor: review the MarkerSetsEditor usage for placing and removing markers on articulated object links
review_ObjectEditor: review the ObjectEditor usage for loading, rotating, and selecting URDF objects in the scene
run_physics_debug_draw: run the viewer with Bullet collision debug draw and contact point visualization enabled
run_navmesh_recompute: run the viewer and recompute the NavMesh with default agent height and radius settings
run_replay_renderer: run the viewer with ReplayRenderer for batch rendering multiple environments from keyframes
review_Timer: review the Timer class that tracks frame duration and guides display frame rate
run_mouse_mode_toggle: run the viewer and toggle between LOOK mode for camera control and MARKER mode for object annotation
